empty.source: DECLARE x VARCHAR2(10) := ''; BEGIN :out := CASE WHEN x IS NULL THEN 'null' ELSE 'text' END; END;

varchar_compare.source: DECLARE x VARCHAR2(3) := 'a'; BEGIN IF x = 'a ' THEN :out := 'true'; ELSE :out := 'false'; END IF; END;
